payload.name: Disrupt-then-reframe (DTR) technique
payload.fact: The disrupt-then-reframe (DTR) technique is a social influence procedure that requires both a small disruption and a direct reframing in that specific sequence to be effective.
payload.boundary: Social influence techniques involving sales requests.

provenance.title: A disrupt-then-reframe technique of social influence.
provenance.quote_or_locus: Studies 2 and 3 showed that the new technique required both the disruption and the new reframing in that sequence
